recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-13174 unless a future work-group decision changes `_count` semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-13174 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It asked whether `_count` constrained total results or requested page size; the accepted resolution was to document `_count` as the maximum number of search results on a page, excluding related resources included by `_include`, `_revinclude`, and OperationOutcomes.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 673c063e2915f5d1d650e3f45183835978859fc0, `GF#13174 - document _count more clearly`, applied svn revision 14187 by changing source/http.html to the accepted page-size wording and changing the history paging sentence to respect `_count` across pages.
additional_context: Current source/search.html has a dedicated `Limiting Page Size (_count)` section that states `_count` limits resources in a single page, requires servers not to exceed the requested page size, says paging links should respect the original count or a server maximum, excludes included resources and operation outcomes, and says `_count` does not affect Bundle.total. Related later decisions FHIR-14852, FHIR-28589, and FHIR-32017 refine adjacent `_count` behavior without changing the FHIR-13174 interpretation.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source change was made because source/http.html and source/search.html already convey the accepted page-size semantics and include the exclusion and Bundle.total clarifications needed to resolve the original ambiguity.

related_jiras.note: Clarified that `_count` does not affect Bundle.total, matching the current search page text that supports the FHIR-13174 page-size interpretation.
Later clarified that paging links should respect the requested `_count` expectations or a server-overridden max page size.
Corrected the `_count` exclusion text to reference `entry.search.mode = match`, preserving the include/outcome exclusion scope relevant to FHIR-13174.
